summary: The first Steering Group meeting for the AITY project focused on reviewing and approving the initial project plan. Key discussions included prototype design, quality targets, and risk management. The plan was approved pending revisions. The team agreed to finalize design documentation before starting coding and to expand the test plan and clarify team roles.
keywords: AITY, AI Agent, Project Plan, Text Analysis, Software Design
topics: Project Governance, Software Development, UI/UX Design
